name: Kin Audio
mission: Open, content-preserving neural audio re-instrumentation: the musician authors the performance; the model changes its body.
current_focus: Train a reference-conditioned polyphonic engine: performance audio defines the content, reference audio defines the target body, and transformation strength is explicit.
principles: Preservation claims require held-out measurements and listening examples.
Code, data, and model weights carry independent explicit licenses.
Training runs are reproducible from a pinned configuration and dataset version.
Every audible control must correspond to a trained or structural model dimension; no cosmetic style knobs.
No proprietary sample library enters a public dataset or released model without permission.

milestones.name: Reproducible research core
milestones.evidence: End-to-end smoke run trained, inferred, and measured 2.1-cent median pitch error with 97.4% voicing overlap.

milestones.name: Open-data baseline
milestones.evidence: StarNet is the first paired benchmark; its CC BY 4.0 provenance and composition-level split are registered.

milestones.name: Polyphonic paired baseline
milestones.evidence: The main model path consumes source audio directly and must support chords, overlapping notes, and monophonic phrases without separate model families.

milestones.name: Reference-conditioned target body
milestones.evidence: A polyphonic smoke engine accepts an independent body reference plus exact dry-to-target strength; mobile inference is live.

milestones.name: Text guidance
milestones.evidence: Text should resolve to the same target-body representation after reference conditioning works on real audio.

product_contract.performance_input: Audio containing the notes, chords, timing, dynamics, and phrasing to preserve.
product_contract.body_reference: Audio exemplifying the instrument or texture that should perform the input content.
product_contract.transformation_strength: A continuous dry-to-target control with exact dry behavior at zero.
product_contract.output: Audio preserving the performance while adopting the referenced body.
product_contract.non_goal: The re-instrumentation engine does not invent new notes or arrangements.
